original.excerpt:
type TLSConfig struct {
	Enabled            bool   `yaml:"enabled"`
	InsecureSkipVerify bool   `yaml:"insecure_skip_verify"`

current.excerpt:

	Enabled            bool   `yaml:"enabled" json:"enabled"`
	InsecureSkipVerify bool   `yaml:"insecure_skip_verify" json:"insecure_skip_verify"`

observation: Snake-case JSON TLS fields insecure_skip_verify, cert_file, key_file and ca_file were not explicitly mapped to the actual TLSConfig structure
required_verification: Canonical snake-case JSON fields survive actual ConfigManager apply and persisted round trip
Previously serialized Go field names, including InsecureSkipVerify/CertFile/KeyFile/CAFile, remain readable or have an explicit compatible conversion
Actual configuration version checks still reject delayed older application; TLS secret values are absent from public evidence
